SPEGIEICATIQM FOR 




DOUBLE ROW CYLINDRICAL ROLLER 

BEARINGS 


1. Scope — Requirements for double row cylindrical roller jjearings. 


2. Terminology — As given in IS : 2399-1964 ' Glossary of terms relating to rolling bearings 

3. Types 

a) Non-locating, and 

b) Two-direction locating. 

3.1 Variations in the above types shall conform to IS: 2398-1967 ' Identification code for rolling bearings 

4. Symbols — Conforming to IS : 2398-1967, 

Dimensions and Tolerances 

5.1 Boundary Dimensions — Dimensions shaM conform to the dimension series 49 and 30 of IS : 5669- 
1970 ' General plan of boundary dimensions for radial roiling bearings'. 

5.2 Tolerances — Tolerances on the boundary dimensions shall conform to IS : 5692-1970 'Tolerances 
for radial rolling bearings 

5.3 Radial Clearances — Shall conform to IS : 5935-1970 ' Radial internal clearances in unloaded radial 
rolling bearings'. 

6, General Requirements — Other requirements for the bearings shall conform to 15 : 6453-1972 
' Technical supply conditions for rolling bearings 

7. Designation — Typical examples:

TO

the subsequent clauses: 

•2 REFERENCES 

The following Indian Standards contain provisions which through 
reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of 
publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to 
revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are 
encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent 
editions of the standards indicated below: 

We

Rolling bearings — Vocabulary ( first revision )

rolling bearings ( first reviaon) 

Tolerances for radial rolling bearings ( first revision ) 

Radial internal clearance in unloaded radial rolling 
bearings ( first revision) 

Technical supply conditions for roiling bearings ( first 
revision)
